name: patsol
description: Claude Code customization for PatSol company work — PR autofix/review, bug and Sentry triage, Jira sync, work journal, new-task pipeline, WandSol time-tracking hook. Environment-specific values are filled in via questions at install time.
description_ko: PatSol 회사 업무용 Claude Code 커스터마이징 — PR 자동수정/리뷰, 버그·Sentry 트리아지, Jira 동기화, 업무 일지, 새 작업 파이프라인, WandSol 시간추적 훅. 환경 종속 값은 설치 시 질문으로 채웁니다.

variables.name: USER_DISPLAY_NAME
variables.question: Your display name? (used in skill, journal, and notification text. e.g. Jane Kim)
variables.question_ko: 본인 표시 이름은? (스킬·일지·알림 문구에 쓰입니다. 예: Jane Kim)

variables.name: GIT_AUTHOR
variables.question: Your git commit author / handle? (matched by git log --author for commit collection. e.g. jkim)
variables.question_ko: git 커밋 author / 핸들은? (git log --author 매칭, 커밋 수집용. 예: jkim)

variables.name: USER_EMAIL
variables.question: Your work email? (used for Jira assignee lookup, etc. e.g. you@yourco.com)
variables.question_ko: 업무 이메일은? (Jira 담당자 조회 등에 사용. 예: you@yourco.com)

variables.name: JIRA_SITE
variables.question: Your Jira site domain? (e.g. yourco.atlassian.net)
variables.question_ko: Jira 사이트 도메인은? (예: yourco.atlassian.net)

variables.name: JIRA_PROJECT_KEY
variables.question: Your Jira project key? (ticket prefix. e.g. PS, ABC)
variables.question_ko: Jira 프로젝트 키는? (티켓 접두사. 예: PS, ABC)

variables.name: GITHUB_ORG
variables.question: Your GitHub organization (org) name? (for repo references. e.g. your-org)
variables.question_ko: GitHub 조직(org) 이름은? (레포 참조용. 예: your-org)

variables.name: BACKEND_REPO_NAME
variables.question: Backend repo name? (must start with REPO_PREFIX to be auto-detected. e.g. acme-back)
variables.question_ko: 백엔드 레포 이름은? (REPO_PREFIX 로 시작해야 자동 감지됩니다. 예: acme-back)

variables.name: FRONTEND_REPO_NAME
variables.question: Frontend repo name? (must start with REPO_PREFIX to be auto-detected. e.g. acme-front)
variables.question_ko: 프론트엔드 레포 이름은? (REPO_PREFIX 로 시작해야 자동 감지됩니다. 예: acme-front)

variables.name: REPO_PREFIX
variables.question: Common prefix of your repo names? (for sibling-repo auto-detection — finds repos above cwd via glob `<prefix>-*`. Your backend/frontend repo names must also start with this prefix. e.g. acme)
variables.question_ko: 레포 이름들의 공통 접두사는? (형제 레포 자동 감지용 — glob `<접두사>-*` 로 cwd 상위에서 레포를 찾습니다. 백엔드/프론트 레포 이름도 이 접두사로 시작해야 합니다. 예: acme)

variables.name: BACKEND_REPO_PATH
variables.question: Local absolute path of the default new-task target (backend) repo? (e.g. ~/work/acme-back)
variables.question_ko: new-task 기본 대상(백엔드) 레포의 로컬 절대경로는? (예: ~/work/acme-back)

variables.name: REPO_ROOT
variables.question: Root directory the work-journal collector scans for git repos? (e.g. ~/work)
variables.question_ko: 업무 일지 수집기가 git 레포를 스캔할 루트 디렉터리는? (예: ~/work)

variables.name: AGENT_RULES_ENV
variables.question: Path to the .env that new-task/apply-review reads? (file holding Jira/Notion tokens. e.g. ~/.config/patsol/patsol.env)
variables.question_ko: new-task/apply-review 가 읽을 .env 경로는? (Jira·Notion 토큰이 든 파일. 예: ~/.config/patsol/patsol.env)

variables.name: SENTRY_ORG
variables.question: Your Sentry organization slug? (the <org> in <org>.sentry.io. e.g. your-org)
variables.question_ko: Sentry 조직 슬러그는? (<org>.sentry.io 의 <org>. 예: your-org)

variables.name: SLACK_WORKSPACE
variables.question: Your Slack workspace subdomain? (the <name> in <name>.slack.com. e.g. yourco)
variables.question_ko: Slack 워크스페이스 서브도메인은? (<name>.slack.com 의 <name>. 예: yourco)

variables.name: SLACK_USER_ID
variables.question: Your Slack member ID? (for the slack-digest routine. optional. e.g. U00000000)
variables.question_ko: 본인 Slack member ID는? (slack-digest 루틴용. 비워도 됨. 예: U00000000)

variables.name: SLACK_HANDLE
variables.question: Your Slack handle / display name? (slack-digest uses it to find you in message bodies. may differ from your git handle. optional. e.g. jane)
variables.question_ko: Slack에서 불리는 핸들/표시명은? (slack-digest 가 메시지 본문에서 나를 찾는 데 씁니다. git 핸들과 다를 수 있음. 비워도 됨. 예: jane)

variables.name: JIRA_CLOUD_ID
variables.question: Your Jira cloud_id? (for the work-journal collector. leave blank if unknown and fill in later)
variables.question_ko: Jira cloud_id는? (업무 일지 수집기용. 모르면 비워두고 나중에 채우세요)

variables.name: JIRA_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.question: Your Jira accountId? (for new-task assignee and the journal. look it up with discover.py)
variables.question_ko: 본인 Jira accountId는? (new-task 담당자 지정·일지용. discover.py 로 조회 가능)

variables.name: JIRA_TEAM_ID
variables.question: team_id of the Jira Team custom field? (for new-task. look it up with discover.py)
variables.question_ko: Jira Team 커스텀 필드의 team_id는? (new-task 용. discover.py 로 조회 가능)

variables.name: NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID
variables.question: Parent Notion page ID for the work journal? (optional)
variables.question_ko: 업무 일지 상위 Notion 페이지 ID는? (비워도 됨)

variables.name: NOTION_TICKET_DB_ID
variables.question: database_id of the work-journal 'ticket' DB? (optional)
variables.question_ko: 업무 일지 '티켓' DB의 database_id는? (비워도 됨)

variables.name: NOTION_TICKET_DS_ID
variables.question: data_source_id of the work-journal 'ticket' DB? (optional)
variables.question_ko: 업무 일지 '티켓' DB의 data_source_id는? (비워도 됨)

variables.name: NOTION_WORK_DB_ID
variables.question: database_id of the work-journal 'work' DB? (optional)
variables.question_ko: 업무 일지 '작업' DB의 database_id는? (비워도 됨)

variables.name: NOTION_WORK_DS_ID
variables.question: data_source_id of the work-journal 'work' DB? (optional)
variables.question_ko: 업무 일지 '작업' DB의 data_source_id는? (비워도 됨)

variables.name: NOTION_DAILY_DB_ID
variables.question: database_id of the work-journal 'daily' DB? (optional)
variables.question_ko: 업무 일지 '일별' DB의 database_id는? (비워도 됨)

variables.name: NOTION_DAILY_DS_ID
variables.question: data_source_id of the work-journal 'daily' DB? (optional)
variables.question_ko: 업무 일지 '일별' DB의 data_source_id는? (비워도 됨)

variables.name: CLAUDE_DIR
variables.question: (auto) Install directory — render.py fills it from the --out value.
variables.question_ko: (자동) 설치 디렉터리 — render.py 가 --out 값으로 자동 채웁니다.

env.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
env.purpose: Base URL for Jira REST calls in new-task/discover (injected via the AGENT_RULES_ENV .env)

env.name: NOTION_API_TOKEN
env.purpose: Notion API token — secret (.env). Used by apply-review/new-task/discover

env.name: NOTION_PLAN_DB_ID
env.purpose: Notion plan DB ID where new-task creates pages (.env)

env.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
env.purpose: Jev (TypeSafe) API key — secret. Set via env var or the ~/.config/jev/api_key file

env.name: SENTRY_TRIAGE_SLACK_WEBHOOK
env.purpose: Slack Incoming Webhook URL for sentry-triage reports — secret

env.name: SENTRY_TRIAGE_ONCALL
env.purpose: On-call Slack member id that sentry-triage mentions (e.g. <@U123ABC>)

env.name: SENTRY_TRIAGE_AUTOFIX
env.purpose: Toggle sentry-triage headless autofix on/off (default on)

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.purpose: For running Claude Code in sentry-triage automation (CI) — secret
